title: Journey to Swing: renderer architecture
summary: Wire UI Swing is a renderer/runtime for compiled WIRE-UI/0.1 facts, not a parallel UI authoring system. Builder journeys, semantic elements, projections, composition, materials and server state remain renderer-neutral; Swing converts the current authoritative semantic view into JComponents.
invariants: Builder authoring truth is semantic and renderer-neutral; DOM, CSS and Swing classes are not authoring truth.
Swing is a renderer profile/capability target, not an interaction-profile fork.
The same compiled release may be rendered by browser and Swing without duplicating journey/business logic.
Swing never becomes journey-transition, business-state, release-selection, experiment, authentication or permission authority.
procedure: Consume server-selected render profile, exact definition manifest, definitions, material set, snapshot and patches.
Maintain an immutable semantic mirror separate from JComponent state.
Translate renderer-neutral composition and primitives into Swing only after semantic preflight.

provenance.claim: Qualified Swing renderer authority boundary and passive-renderer architecture.
Builder is a fact editor for flow and remains renderer-neutral.
